title: MarineSparkLM-4B: A Lightweight Language Model for Marine and Offshore Engineering Built by Parameter-Efficient Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2611.19151v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Marine and offshore engineering text is spread across preprints, open-access journals, encyclopedias and institutional documents, and the amount of it is small by pretraining standards. We ask how far a lightweight language model for marine and offshore engineering can be taken with parameter-efficient adaptation on a single workstation-class device. Starting from the 4-billion-parameter OceanGPT-basic-4B-Instruct, we train two independent LoRA adapters, each updating 33.0 million of 4.06 billion parameters (0.81%). Training took 4 hours 40 minutes for the first adapter and 10 minutes for the second on one NVIDIA DGX Spark. The first adapter is trained by next-token prediction on a 61.6-million-token corpus covering ten engineering themes. translated_title: MarineSparkLM-4B：基于参数高效适配构建的海洋与离岸工程轻量级语言模型
translated_abstract: 海洋与离岸工程领域的文本散布于预印本、开放获取期刊、百科全书和机构文档之中，且按预训练标准衡量其规模很小。我们探究的问题是：依靠参数高效适配，在一台工作站级单机上，面向海洋与离岸工程的轻量级语言模型究竟能走多远。从40亿参数的OceanGPT-basic-4B-Instruct出发，我们训练了两个独立的LoRA适配器，每个适配器仅更新40.6亿参数中的3300万（即0.81%）。在单台NVIDIA DGX Spark上，第一个适配器训练耗时4小时40分钟，第二个仅耗时10分钟。第一个适配器通过下一词元预测任务，在覆盖十个工程主题、共6160万词元的语料库上训练。该语料库由13,879份源文档构建，经去重和去除跨领域词汇冲突的两级关键词过滤后保留了7,069份文档。其验证损失……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 该研究通过在一台工作站级设备上仅对40亿参数模型进行0.81%参数量的LoRA高效适配，并以约5小时的低算力成本，构建出面向海洋与离岸工程领域的轻量级专用语言模型MarineSparkLM-4B。
